comment: Area 1 (alley) sprites and background. Style: the plan's 'inked watercolour' hybrid (§8.1). Keep every full prompt within 77 CLIP tokens; generate.py refuses longer ones. Framing v1 is pass 1's (isolation words at the end); v2 puts them straight after the style, which frames sprites better.
style: children's picture book illustration, soft watercolour fills, bold dark ink outlines
